sn9.6:1.1: I have heard that on one occasion Ven. Anuruddha was staying among the Kosalans in a forest grove. Now at that time,
sn9.6:1.2: a devatā from the retinue of the heaven of the Thirty-three named Jālinī, one of Ven. Anuruddha’s former consorts, went to him and, on arrival, addressed him with this verse:
sn9.6:2.2: to where you used to live,
sn9.6:2.3: among the Devas of the Thirty-three,
sn9.6:2.6: by deva maidens, you will shine.”
sn9.6:3.1: Ven. Anuruddha: “They’ve gone astray, deva maidens
sn9.6:3.2: established in self-identity. And they’ve gone astray,
sn9.6:4.1: as their aim.” Jālinī: “They don’t know bliss
sn9.6:5.1: Ven. Anuruddha: “You fool, don’t you know
sn9.6:5.4: Their nature: to arise & pass away. They disband as they are arising.
sn9.6:6.2: Jālinī, there is now in deva company no further abode (for me).
sn9.6:6.3: With the utter ending of wandering on in birth,
sn9.6:6.4: there is now no further becoming.”
